description: Main source code for Bluetooth periodic advertising synchronization demo using Zephyr RTOS, including Bluetooth initialization, scanning, sync creation, and LED control.

methods.name: blink_timeout
methods.description: Callback function to toggle LED state and reschedule blinking.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse Bluetooth advertisement data and extract device name.

methods.name: phy2str
methods.description: Converts PHY value to human-readable string.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Handles received scan data, processes advertisement info, and signals when periodic advertising is found.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback for terminated periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving data during periodic sync.
